import math

# Values for Rural Electrification Administration (in millions of dollars)
values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

# Method 1: Theil's original formula
theil1 = 0
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil1 += ratio * math.log(ratio)
theil1 = theil1 / n

# Method 2: Alternative formula T = ln(mean) - mean(ln(x))
ln_mean = math.log(mean)
mean_ln = sum(math.log(v) for v in values) / n
theil2 = ln_mean - mean_ln

print(f"Method 1 (original formula): {theil1}")
print(f"Method 2 (alternative formula): {theil2}")
print(f"Both equal: {abs(theil1 - theil2) < 0.0001}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(theil1, 3)}")
